events.title: Trinity's capture turns into a massacre
events.summary: Four cops breach Room 303 and force Trinity, found at a computer, into apparent surrender; the biggest of them reaches with the cuffs and she converts that contact into a massacre, killing the whole squad in seconds and standing alone over them. Outside, Agents Smith, Brown and Jones arrive, and Smith tells the Lieutenant that the two units he sent in are already dead, while the Lieutenant dismisses them. The raid the police treated as a routine collar is revealed, in the same building, to have been a slaughter from the off.
events.action: The squad corners a lone woman and the Big Cop extends his hands for the restraints, and Trinity converts that contact into a massacre; outside, the Agents strip the Lieutenant of his operation while he dismisses them.

He never gets to know he was wrong; his certainty and his life end in the same instant, which is what makes him the perfect foil for what Trinity actually is.

events.title: Trinity's escape across the rooftops to the phone
events.summary: Trinity is the sole survivor standing over dead cops when Agents confirm her presence and cut her traced hardline. Morpheus, already aware, steers her to a phone at Wells and Lake. She bolts through the hall past Agent Brown and his police unit, out a broken window onto the fire escape, and up once Agent Smith blocks the alley below. On the roof she clears a 40-foot gap with committed, gliding movement while the cops falter and Agent Brown duplicates the leap exactly. She dives across a paved chasm toward the yellow glow of the far building, crashes through a window into a back stairwell, and—battered and bleeding—draws her gun on the opening, finds no pursuer, then forces herself down the stairs and out. On the street she reaches the Wells and Lake phone a moment before a garbage truck destroys the booth, answers it, and is gone. The Agents are left with no body but the name of the crew's next target: Neo.
events.action: Trinity loses her traced hardline and is directed by Morpheus to a phone at Wells and Lake. She runs through the hall past Agent Brown and his police unit, out a broken window onto the fire escape, and upward when Agent Smith blocks the alley below. On the roof she clears a 40-foot gap while the cops falter and Agent Brown duplicates the leap with the same unnatural grace. She drives off the edge into a dive across a paved chasm, crashes through a window onto a back stairwell, and—bleeding and broken—checks the opening for pursuit, finds only wind, then limps down the stairs under her own power. events.title: Neo is summoned and drawn toward the truth
events.summary: Alone in his apartment, Neo is shaken out of ordinary sleep by his own PC typing messages that name him and command him to follow a white rabbit; a real knock answers the last line, and when a visitor arrives wearing a small white rabbit pin he commits to leaving with her. At a crowded, black-clad gathering, Trinity finds him by name, confirms she was the one on his computer, warns him he is being watched and is in danger, and turns his private obsession into a named quest — 'What is the Matrix?' — before vanishing, leaving him standing alone and out of place with the hook set.
events.action: The machine addresses Neo directly and a knock answers it, collapsing the boundary between screen and reality; then a planted symbol converts a routine deal into an abduction-by-invitation. Across both rooms, an unseen sender steers him from solitary refusal toward a guide who names his longing and withholds the answer, so that he moves by pull rather than explanation — from confident cause-and-effect into a doubting seeker, and from wary suspicion of an unknown caller into being drawn in by Trinity's hypnotic voice.

events.title: Neo's ordinary life reasserts itself
events.summary: An alarm drags Neo out of the night's dislocation and into a mundane morning; registering with irritation that he is late, he is pulled back into the rhythm of an ordinary workday. Hauled before RHINEHEART at the downtown headquarters of Meta CorTechs, a software development firm, he is forced from his anonymous hacker identity back into being an employee under discipline, submitted to an explicit ultimatum about his job. He answers the demand with detached, surface-level compliance while his mind stays on the window cleaners outside, the ordinary world's demand for conformity burying the pull toward the unknown.
events.action: An alarm wakes Neo, and he registers with irritation that he is late, dragged out of the night and back into an ordinary workday. An establishing shot identifies the setting as the headquarters of Meta CorTechs, a software development firm. Inside, RHINEHEART lectures NEO without even looking at him, absorbed in his own work, then openly asserts the company's authority and demands NEO's conformity as 'a part of a whole', delivering an ultimatum about his job. NEO answers with flat, deferential compliance while his attention stays fixed on the window cleaners outside.

prose_before_reconcile.summary: After the night's intrusion, Neo is dragged back into his routine by an alarm that catches him late, then hauled before his boss at Meta CorTechs, where he is lectured about his attitude, told he is not special, and forced to submit to an ultimatum about his job. He answers with flat, deferential compliance while his attention stays fixed on the window cleaners outside, the ordinary world reasserting its claim over him.
prose_before_reconcile.action: The alarm clock wakes Neo in his apartment; he reads 9:15 A.M. on the clock-face and curses his lateness. An establishing shot names the downtown headquarters of Meta CorTechs, a software firm. Inside, RHINEHEART lectures NEO without looking at him, typing continuously, while NEO stares at two window cleaners dragging their squeegees down the glass. RHINEHEART accuses him of believing the rules do not apply to him, frames the company as a whole that every employee must serve, and delivers an either/or ultimatum: be at his start showing up at your desk on time from now on, or find another job. NEO answers, 'Yes, Mr. Rhineheart. Perfectly clear.'
prose_before_reconcile.turns_on: Neo's outward compliance — his flat 'Perfectly clear' — which lets the ordinary world believe it has disciplined him even as his mind stays elsewhere, the gap between surface submission and inner detachment that the coming enforcement will close.

events.title: The Agents seize Neo at the office
events.summary: A delivered phone puts Morpheus on the line to warn Neo that pursuers are closing in for reasons no one will explain, then guides him through the cubicle maze; Neo slips past the search but, at the window, refuses the climb to the roof, loses his balance and his phone to a gust, and retreats inside, where the Agents take him into physical custody. affects_outside.enables: Neo's capture delivers him into the Agents' hands and sets the interrogation-and-physical-modification sequence in motion, while giving Morpheus's crew the hard proof that remote guidance and fear are not enough to make him ready.

events.turns_on: Neo's failure of belief on the ledge—his terror at the height and his collapse into arguing that he is nobody—drives him back inside and hands him to the very custody he feared, while Morpheus's remote guidance proves unable to steady Neo's body for him.
